syllabus_anchor_candidates.anchor: TO begin with the first thing proposed: The church of Christ living in this world, as to our present concernment, is taken in Scripture three ways: —

items.text: For the mystical body of Christ, his elect, redeemed, justified, and sanctified ones throughout the world; commonly called the church catholic militant.
For the universality of men throughout the world called by the preaching of the word, visibly professing and yielding obedience to the gospel; called by some the church catholic visible.
For a particular church of some place, wherein the instituted worship of God in Christ is celebrated according to his mind.
